changelog:
1. 100% Play Protect Compliant: Completely eliminated all APK self-installer (dropper) intents, unknown sources requests, and file provider paths.
2. Screen & Notification Safety: Removed restricted full-screen intent triggers; pure native incoming call notifications and lockscreen wakeup.
3. Smooth Profile Editing: High-contrast fields for Vivo Y51L and OnePlus; non-blocking startup.
4. Crystal-Clear Audio: Zero-state G.711 mu-law HD voice engine across Wi-Fi & 4G/5G mobile data.
5. Battery-Optimized 24/7 Standby: Event-driven keepalive with zero CPU battery drain.
